essence: Each deity requires a recitation of one hundred thousand syllables using its own seed name.
The prescribed recitation must be performed together with the three sweet substances.
Those Baṭuka deities grant the desired fruits to the practitioner.
The practitioner should utter the nine-syllabled mantra 'hastipiśāci iti liḥliḥsvāhā'.
This mantra is declared to be a giver of all prosperity.
